Core_Claim: The narrative distributes focalization across multiple distinct perspectives to mirror networked modern warfare.
Primary_Evidence_Source: Campaign mission flow across SAS, USMC, Al-Fulani, and AC-130 operator
Interpretive_Significance: Rejects the singular heroic protagonist in favor of distributed procedural citizenship.

Core_Claim: Infinity Ward executed a mid-production reboot in 2006 after spending a year building only Middle Eastern desert militia levels.
Primary_Evidence_Source: McCandlish & Boon (2008), Game Developer magazine postmortem
Corroborating_Missions_or_Assets: Cut levels; addition of SAS and Chernobyl missions
Interpretive_Significance: Proves the dual-theatre narrative was an emergent solution to creative monotony rather than an initial grand plan.

Core_Claim: All Ghillied Up was developed covertly by Mohammad Alavi against initial internal studio skepticism.
Primary_Evidence_Source: Alavi (2023), GameSpot interview by D. Hornshaw
Corroborating_Missions_or_Assets: M13 All Ghillied Up; custom line-of-sight AI scripting
Interpretive_Significance: Demonstrates that the game's greatest tension was engineered through stillness and vulnerability rather than shooting.

Core_Claim: The game constructs Middle Eastern spaces as chaotic and denies Arab subjects authentic political agency.
Primary_Evidence_Source: The Coup execution of Al-Fulani; nameless 'small oil-rich country'
Corroborating_Missions_or_Assets: M03 The Coup; M05 Charlie Don't Surf; M10 Shock and Awe
Interpretive_Significance: Encodes neocolonial hegemony: Western intervention is framed as the sole mechanism capable of restoring order.

Core_Claim: The perception of realism is generated by superfluous micro-details (the Reality Effect) rather than geopolitical truth.
Primary_Evidence_Source: Weapon scratches, dust cover flips, military brevity codes (Oscar Mike, Tango Down)
Corroborating_Missions_or_Assets: M01 F.N.G.; M08 Death From Above; weapon reload animations
Interpretive_Significance: Hyper-authentic tactical signifiers persuade players to unconsciously accept an ideologically loaded fictional conflict.

Core_Claim: The game hyper-realizes tactical weapons handling while filtering out civilian casualties and long-term aftermath.
Primary_Evidence_Source: Absence of non-combatant civilians; instant fail-state on friendly fire; ragdoll deaths
Corroborating_Missions_or_Assets: Entire campaign; game over screen: 'Friendly fire will not be tolerated!'
Interpretive_Significance: Sanitizes state violence into a clean

Core_Claim: Death From Above exemplifies virtuous war by transforming lethal force into an abstracted
Academic_Citation: AC-130 105mm/40mm/25mm FLIR interface; casual radio banter ('Kaboom', 'Good kill')
Interpretive_Significance: M08 Death From Above; FLIR CRT monitor display
column9: Dramatizes the ultimate technocratic detachment of modern imperial violence from physical suffering.

Core_Claim: Aftermath shatters player empowerment by forcing the player to inhabit a dying soldier stripped of all combat mechanics.
Primary_Evidence_Source: Loss of HUD, weapons, sprint; slow crawl; flatlining heart rate monitor
Corroborating_Missions_or_Assets: M10 Shock and Awe; M11 Aftermath
column9: confronting the player with the catastrophic reality of nuclear destruction.

Core_Claim: Captain Price's leadership of Soap replicates his own historical mentorship under Captain MacMillan in 1996.
Primary_Evidence_Source: Dialogue echoes between MacMillan (1996) and Price (2011); carrying wounded comrades
Corroborating_Missions_or_Assets: M01 F.N.G.; M13 All Ghillied Up; M14 One Shot One Kill; M20 Game Over
Interpretive_Significance: Constructs a generational lineage of professional special-forces tradecraft and moral duty.

Core_Claim: Multiplayer strips campaign spaces of tragedy
Evidence_Type: converting nuclear ruins into dopamine-driven competitive playgrounds.
Academic_Citation: Crash map remediating the nuclear helicopter crash site; XP and Prestige loops
column9: Exposes the commercial schizophrenia of militainment: mourning war in narrative while commodifying it in play.

Core_Claim: Raven Software preserved exact 60Hz tick-rate and movement timing while completely overhauling the visual engine.
Primary_Evidence_Source: Identical acceleration, mantle, jump, and recoil parameters; rebuilt PBR shaders
Corroborating_Missions_or_Assets: 2007 IW3 vs. 2016 MWR engine comparison; 10 launch maps + 6 post-launch
Interpretive_Significance: Achieves mechanical parity while updating surface rendering to match the player's idealized nostalgic memory.

Core_Claim: The addition of the Depot supply drop system in late 2016 broke the historical preservation ethos of the remaster.
Primary_Evidence_Source: Loot boxes, weapon camos, melee weapons (shovels), and brand-new functional firearms (Mac-10)
Corroborating_Missions_or_Assets: MWR December 2016 update; Depot store interface
Interpretive_Significance: Illustrates how live-service monetization models inevitably supersede the historical integrity of classic games.

Core_Claim: Bullet penetration mechanics dismantled traditional opaque cover
Academic_Citation: Caliber-dependent material penetration (drywall, wood, cinderblock, sheet metal)
Interpretive_Significance: All campaign missions; Deep Impact perk in multiplayer
column9: Procedurally communicates that physical shelter in modern combat is fragile and contingent on ballistic caliber.

Core_Claim: The tinnitus audio filter simulates concussive bodily trauma by replacing the soundscape with a high-pitched tone.
Primary_Evidence_Source: Muted master audio, ringing sine wave, heavy heartbeat following explosions
Corroborating_Missions_or_Assets: M02 Crew Expendable; M11 Aftermath; M20 Game Over
column9: using acoustic deprivation to convey the somatic shock of war.

Core_Claim: The final Russian media broadcast cynically covers up the ICBM crisis as a routine naval training exercise.
Primary_Evidence_Source: Russian news radio report over the credits: 'routine missile training exercise'
Corroborating_Missions_or_Assets: M20 Game Over end cutscene and audio broadcast
column9: concluding that 21st-century secret wars occur in deliberate democratic darkness.
